title: K'taka CM defends ₹8 per litre milk price hike, says farmers will benefit
description:
Karnataka Chief Minister D K Shivakumar on Saturday defended the milk price hike, saying it was necessary to safeguard farmers' interests, particularly when the state was reeling under severe drought.
He said the decision also reflected the government's reverence for the cow, regarded as a mother, and its commitment to protecting cattle.
The Karnataka Cabinet on Thursday approved a Rs 8 per litre increase in milk prices across all categories.
According to Shivakumar, milk producers had sought a hike of Rs 12 per litre.
"Prices are much higher in neighbouring states, and farmers in Karnataka were moving their milk to those states. Milk availability is declining as well. Due to drought, milk production has come down," Shivakumar told reporters here.
